recent_tweets.text:
exploring ways to spin up agents from my phone

iOS shortcuts × github actions × cursor cli

world_signals: affordable electric trucks rolling onto American roads
European paperwork still outlasting founder patience
record heat dimming lights across France
sailors stranded in narrow waters awaiting rescue
overcast San Francisco morning holding cool air before a long summer sunset
solstice week — quiet repos, loud headphones

composer-2.5-fast.concept: Sample-pad rhythm game synced to a stuttering house beat — each missed tap glitches the track and adds a visual stutter layer you must tap through to restore the drop.
composer-2.5-fast.session_hook: nailing one 45-second drop feels like a Fred again.. live loop closing perfectly
composer-2.5-fast.escalation: BPM creeps up, pad positions shuffle mid-bar, ghost notes appear
composer-2.5-fast.aesthetic: neon waveform club, pulsing stutter-house visuals

gpt-5.5-extra-high.concept: Flick circuit breakers to reroute power during a cascading French heatwave blackout — each flick saves a district but risks overloading neighboring grids.
gpt-5.5-extra-high.session_hook: saving one more block before the whole map goes dark
gpt-5.5-extra-high.escalation: outages chain faster, wires glow amber-hot, repair windows shrink

claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.concept: Draw safe channels through shifting strait currents to guide stranded ships toward open water before the tide reverses.
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.session_hook: each vessel that slips through the narrow exit stacks your rescue count
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.escalation: currents widen unpredictably, rocks emerge, fog rolls in mid-route
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.aesthetic: watercolor nautical chart, ink bleeding at the edges

gemini-3.1-pro.concept: Sort startup paperwork into bureaucratic lanes — stamp, file, reject — before a 152-day clock expires and you still can't send an invoice.
gemini-3.1-pro.session_hook: clearing a week's pile in one frantic minute of filing
gemini-3.1-pro.escalation: forms multiply, stamp ink runs dry, wrong-lane fines stack
gemini-3.1-pro.aesthetic: paper cutout office absurdism, muted euro bureaucrat palette
